_doc: AML-GOALS R3: the record of registered evaluation and robustness looks (pre-registration 3.6.0). A registered look appends its seed here when it starts (state started: the seed is spent from then on, whatever happens next) and its report sha256 before any verdict is printed (state complete): scripts/aml_gate.py --registered does both, and refuses to start on a checkout with uncommitted changes to tracked files; the cluster driver refuses registered looks. A held-out seed retired without a look (public, or voided) is recorded with state burned and the owner's reason (config/datagen_seed.py burn_seed). config/datagen_seed.py treats every seed here as spent. Commit this file after a look; never edit or remove an entry.
